This barley plot is small, just a little piece near the house, but it is mine and I have grown barley here many seasons. I have no money to waste — one full bag of DAP is too much for this small plot, but the cooperative sometimes gives a little on credit, so I will take a small amount and share a bag with my sister who also grows barley. I keep my own seed from last year because it grew well and I trust it. I will put the cattle manure from our kraal on this plot like I always do, and my daughter and I will do the weeding ourselves.
